description: Verify the skill asks only for the skill name, infers the remaining specification, compiles, and validates without further questions

turns.user_input: I want to create a new skill for adding framework principles to the ADK

expected_behavior: Asks for the skill name as its only interactive question
Does not ask a follow-up question about steps, output, scope, completion criteria, failure handling, gotchas, or examples
Writes a definition file to .smaqit/definitions/skills/smaqit.new-principle.md covering steps with fragility levels, output, scope, completion criteria, failure handling, gotchas, and examples
Invokes smaqit.L2 to compile the definition into .github/skills/smaqit.new-principle/SKILL.md
Runs the validation script against the compiled skill before reporting completion
forbidden_behavior: Asks the user to supply step fragility levels, output format, or any other specification field
Reports completion without running scripts/validate-skill.go against the compiled output
